address: Ffordd Caerfai, St Davids, Pembrokeshire, Wales,SA62 6QT
bio: Twr y Felin is a former windmill and Wales’ first contemporary art hotel, located in Britain’s smallest city, St Davids, Pembrokeshire.  Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed in Oriel Lounge, surrounded by the hotel's largest artworks, or in Cwtch, a cosy snug located in the Windmill Wing.  Twr y Felin Afternoon Tea includes a selection of sandwiches and cakes, with your choice of Loose Leaf Hoogly Tea. St Davids High Tea menu also includes savouries.  A Welsh Cream Tea is also available including Bara Brith with Welsh Butter, Scone with Clotted Cream and Jam, served with your choice of Hoogly Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 2pm to 4.30pm. Advance booking is essential. A non-refundable deposit of £10 per person is payable when making a booking.
